verdict.rationale: iTerm2 supports bulk work across sessions mainly through scripting. The Python API offers 'full automation' that lets you 'touch pretty much everything,' and AppleScript can open multiple sessions into new tabs or windows. Global Search also covers all tabs at once, but no first-class bulk-action feature is evidenced. missing for 10: explicit bulk/broadcast operations across many sessions (e.g. sending input to all panes at once), documented batch-operation semantics, hands-on corroboration of bulk scripting.
